summary: American Express Receivables Financing Corporation III LLC, as depositor, filed an 8-K reporting that the American Express Credit Account Master Trust issued $1.25 billion of Class A 4.99% Asset Backed Certificates, Series 2026-1 and $53.572 million of Class B 5.39% Asset Backed Certificates, Series 2026-1 on September 22, 2026, supplementing its Fourth Amended and Restated Pooling and Servicing Agreement dated April 1, 2018. Bank of New York Mellon serves as trustee. This is a routine credit-card ABS securitization issuance, not a special situation; no equity stake, corporate control change, premium, or break fee is involved. Watch for pool performance and certificate spread.
